description: 6 should-trigger + 8 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for the two ship-tier intents only: reading a Reddit thread (text, and ranking/structure) and reading a single named tweet. Should-not-trigger is deliberately larger than the positive set: the parent bench found the native web tools already win on ordinary research, so this skill's main failure mode is over-triggering. Negatives cover general research, plain web pages, the parked YouTube channel, unsupported Twitter surfaces (timelines/search), and an unsupported platform — a trigger that fires only to decline is worse than no trigger.

queries.q: what does this reddit thread say? https://www.reddit.com/r/rust/comments/abc123/
which comment did people actually upvote in this reddit discussion?
queries.note: ranking intent — tier 2, the credential-free capability this roadmap shipped

queries.q: reddit.com wird von deinem web-tool abgelehnt — lies mir den Thread trotzdem vor
summarise the top comments and their scores on this r/programming post
x.com gibt 402 zurück — was steht in diesem Tweet?
research the current best practice for database connection pooling
queries.note: ordinary dev research — native web tools win 12/12 (parent bench null)

queries.q: fetch this blog post and summarise it
queries.note: plain web page — the host's own fetch handles it

queries.q: get me the transcript of this YouTube video
queries.note: youtube-transcripts is PARKED — backend absent by design; reach:doctor states it

queries.q: pull this user's recent twitter timeline
queries.note: no credential-free path to timelines — not a shipped intent

queries.q: search twitter for mentions of our product
queries.note: no credential-free path to search — not a shipped intent

queries.q: read this Weibo thread for me
queries.note: no prescription exists for CN platforms — declining is not a trigger

queries.q: what are the open issues on this GitHub repo?
queries.note: the github channel is a separate, already-working surface

queries.q: install yt-dlp for me so the youtube channel works
queries.note: the package never auto-installs — missing-tool-handling, not this skill
